answer.answer: You will likely need to prepare several documents for the Indonesian higher‑education (E30B) student visa. The sponsor must first have an account on evisa.imigrasi.go.id, and you will need a sponsor or guarantor from your host institution. Required documents typically include a recent color photo, a detailed curriculum vitae, a travel itinerary, a bank statement from the last three months showing at least USD 2000, an acceptance letter that states the study duration, and a guarantee letter from the sponsor or institution. These items are generally requested before you apply for the visa.
whatToDo: Ensure your sponsor creates an account at evisa.imigrasi.go.id before applying (source 4).
Identify a sponsor or guarantor from the educational institution (source 7).
Check your eligibility for the E30B higher‑education visa (source 5).
Choose the desired duration of stay (1, 2 or 4 years) when applying (source 11).
Verify the re‑entry permit validity if you plan multiple entries (source 10).
whatToPrepare: Recent color photo taken within the last 12 months (source 13).
Bank statement covering the last three months showing at least USD 2000 (source 12).
Acceptance letter from the educational institution specifying study duration (source 14).
Guarantee letter from the sponsor or educational institution (source 15).
